description: Management-plane SSE event contract (rebuild plan 14, R0.6/D7). Single endpoint GET /api/wr/events on the management port (3462), auth = management token. Framing: `event: <type>` + `data: <json>` + blank line, media_type text/event-stream. The Rust management server (R5) must emit identical event types with identical framing; parity diffs exclude all fields marked volatile.

data.description: Reserved by D7; fields finalized when first emitter lands. Must carry a scope hint (e.g. providers|api-keys|routing) so clients can invalidate narrowly.
Reserved by D7. Must be emitted per persisted request-log row (respecting the callLogs switch, C3) with at least the row id for targeted refetch.
Reserved by D7. Coalescing allowed; must not carry secrets.

events.since: 2026-09-26 call-logs status rework (Rust, no Python mirror)

phase.description: pending = admitted, not yet dispatching upstream; processing = upstream call in progress; first-byte = first streamed chunk observed (TTFT now available in the in-flight row)

data.description: Emitted when an authenticated request registers in the in-flight registry (pending) and when it acquires a concurrency permit (processing). Completion is still signalled by log-appended; clients invalidate call-logs queries.

reason.description: why the process is stopping (e.g. shutdown)

data.description: Emitted to every connected SSE client right before the management plane ends the event stream during process shutdown. Semantics: the stop request was ACCEPTED, the process has NOT exited yet. Clients must switch to a stopping UI state and cancel their reconnect loop; the process exit itself is confirmed by the management endpoint becoming unreachable.

reconnect.lastEventId: not supported in R0 (no replay); clients refetch active queries after reconnect
